title: Golf, Courier, and a Ticket to Voronezh

scenes.title: Football or Love?
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov promises Elena to put her before football, while Vika complains to Nagiyev that Barinov fired the delivery courier.

scenes.title: A Day Off for Vika
scenes.summary: Nagiyev celebrates buying out Kristina's share of the restaurant and gives Vika the afternoon off for a date at home.

scenes.title: Max's Return to the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Nagiyev tells Max to stop working in the dining room and orders Chef Barinov to take Max back into the kitchen.

scenes.title: The Chef's Little Request
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov asks Nagiyev to cover for him with Elena Pavlovna so he can watch the Spartak football match.

scenes.title: Any Outcome of the Match
scenes.summary: Nagiyev jokes that Barinov drinks whether his team wins, loses, or draws, and agrees to let Max return to the kitchen.

scenes.title: Lying on the Phone
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov blames Nagiyev on the phone to Elena Pavlovna, only to realize Elena is standing right behind him.

scenes.title: The Offended Actor
scenes.summary: After overhearing Chef Barinov insult his acting, Nagiyev gets revenge by giving Barinov the day off to go with Elena.

scenes.title: Cleaner's Assistant or Courier
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov tells Max that although he took him back into the kitchen, Max will work as a food delivery courier.

scenes.title: A Ruined Suit and Golf Clothes
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov ruins his suit hoping to stay behind, but Elena dresses him in golf clothes for an afternoon on the course.

scenes.title: Introductions at the Golf Club
scenes.summary: Elena introduces Chef Barinov to her friends from India, and Barinov is horrified to learn how long a round of golf takes.

scenes.title: Career Growth and the First Swing
scenes.summary: Max jokes with Kostya about going from cleaner to courier in an hour, while Chef Barinov learns the basic golf swing.

scenes.title: A Sunken Golf Club and Lunch Delivery
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov throws his golf club into the water, while Nagiyev and Vika receive their lunch delivery at Vika's apartment.

scenes.title: The Courier at Vika's Door
scenes.summary: Delivering lunch to Vika's apartment, Max sees Nagiyev there and lies that he has been offered a sous-chef job at a new restaurant.

scenes.title: A Ticket to Voronezh
scenes.summary: Vika sends Nagiyev home saying they should not rush, while Max books a one-way night train ticket back to Voronezh.

scenes.title: The Chef's Trick and Max's News
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov fakes a sprained ankle to sneak away to watch football, while Max tells the kitchen crew he is quitting.

scenes.title: Busted at the Clubhouse
scenes.summary: Elena catches Chef Barinov jumping around watching football on TV, leading to a heated argument about her friends.

scenes.title: Max's Send-Off and the Courier's Arrival
scenes.summary: The kitchen crew toasts Max's departure, Chef Barinov berates him as a traitor, and a courier delivers Max's train ticket.

scenes.title: Max's Bitter Truth
scenes.summary: Seeing the ticket to Voronezh, Chef Barinov calls Max a coward, and Max fires back about how Barinov treats his staff.

scenes.title: Conversation in the Courtyard
scenes.summary: Max says goodbye to the crew, and Chef Barinov follows him outside to tell him not to run away to Voronezh.

scenes.title: Inevitable Changes
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov brings Max back as a cook, and after Elena kicks Barinov out, he asks Lyova for a place to stay.
